description: Get the active company's QFZP (Qualifying Free Zone Person) status for UAE Corporate Tax. Returns the qualifying/non-qualifying income split, de minimis status (ok / warning / breach), free zone name, substance declaration state, and per-zone smart hints (e.g. audited accounts requirement, designated zone VAT, trade license expiry). Returns `applicable: false` for UK or UAE mainland companies. Use when the user asks about QFZP status, whether they still qualify, their de minimis headroom, or whether they'll owe 9% CT.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

name: get_qfzp_status
title: Get Qfzp Status
